summary: Inovio Pharmaceuticals filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a marketed follow-on equity offering of 58,747,235 common shares and pre-funded warrants for 12,681,337 shares. The public offering price is $1.05 per share and $1.049 per pre-funded warrant (exercise price $0.001), for gross proceeds of about $74.99 million, or roughly $70.49 million net before expenses. A 30-day underwriter option covers up to 10,714,285 additional shares. Jefferies and Piper Sandler are joint book-runners, H.C. Wainwright lead manager. Closing expected November 9, 2026. Watch pricing versus the $1.45 prior close and warrant overhang.
